Syllabus (approx. weightage out of 100)

SectionMarksTopics
GK and current affairs25Politics, environment, science and technology, economy, Punjab history from the 14th century, Indian freedom struggle, sports, cinema and literature
Mental ability25Coding-decoding, analogy, classification, series, directions, blood relations, mathematical operations, Venn diagrams, cubes and dice, mirror images, puzzles, non-verbal reasoning
Mathematical skills25Number system, LCM and HCF, percentage, ratio, average, ages, profit and loss, interest, time and work, time and distance, mensuration, data interpretation
Punjabi13Spelling, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms, parts of speech, gender and number, idioms, translation from English
English12Grammar, synonyms and antonyms, one-word substitution, fill in the blanks, sentence correction, narration, voice, idioms
